instruction: Fix `moving_average` so it only produces full windows of `window` elements (the current range over-iterates and emits trailing partial windows).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/numstats.py b/numstats.py
--- a/numstats.py
+++ b/numstats.py
@@ -37,7 +37,7 @@
 
 def moving_average(values, window):
     """Return the moving average of ``values`` over ``window``."""
-    return [sum(values[i:i + window]) / window for i in range(len(values))]
+    return [sum(values[i:i + window]) / window for i in range(len(values) - window + 1)]
